City Centre (Ward 11) — Edinburgh, United Kingdom

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

By far Edinburgh's highest-crime ward: 267.7 crimes per 1,000 population in 2023/24, more than double the next-highest ward and driven by the dense concentration of pubs, clubs, tourist footfall and retail theft in the Old Town/New Town core. Genuine, dated local press coverage also documents recurring nightlife-related disturbances specifically around the Cowgate/Grassmarket area: on the night of 20 September 2025 police responded to a disturbance outside a Grassmarket bar in which a 28-year-old man was hospitalised and a 39-year-old man was arrested and charged (Edinburgh News, 21 Sep 2025). Day and night are both red here on the strength of the underlying rate alone; the Cowgate/Grassmarket incident is additional, specific corroboration for the night rating rather than the basis for it. Sources checked: Churchill Support Services / Scottish Daily Express, 28 Nov 2024; datamap-scotland.co.uk Police Scotland ward crime map, data to end 2025; Edinburgh News, 21 Sep 2025 (Grassmarket/Cowgate disturbance).

Frequently asked questions

Is City Centre (Ward 11) safe?

Wandroz currently rates City Centre (Ward 11) in Edinburgh, United Kingdom as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered during the day and an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is City Centre (Ward 11) safe at night?

At night, City Centre (Ward 11) is rated as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is City Centre (Ward 11) a good area to stay in as a tourist?

City Centre (Ward 11)'s day rating (an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
